description: The plot illustrates the relationship between activated parameter ratio and evaluation perplexity (PPL) for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 25 to 100, in increments of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" with a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, in increments of 0.5. The line representing "Transformer" is dashed and orange, beginning at a value of approximately 11.6 at an activated parameter ratio of 100 and decreasing to approximately 11.5 at a ratio of 25. The line representing "Only MoHD FFN" is solid and gray, with square markers, starting at approximately 12.2 at a ratio of 100, decreasing to 11.8 at a ratio of 75, further decreasing to 11.7 at a ratio of 50, and then increasing to approximately 12.1 at a ratio of 25. The line representing "Only MoHD ATTN" is solid and dark blue, with circular markers, starting at approximately 12.0 at a ratio of 100, decreasing to 11.9 at a ratio of 75, then decreasing to 11.8 at a ratio of 50, and increasing to approximately 13.0 at a ratio of 25. Lastly, the line representing "MoHD ATTN + MLP" is solid and light blue, with cross markers, beginning at approximately 13.1 at a ratio of 100, decreasing to 12.5 at a ratio of 75, then decreasing to 12.1 at a ratio of 50, and increasing to approximately 13.1 at a ratio of 25.
